title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
headline: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
ai_overview: Gemini 4 Carbon: our next frontier model Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities. Carbon ranks #1 on the recently updated v5.0 of Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 59.
ai_what_happened: It shows significant gains across coding and agentic tasks as well as across key capabilities critical for cybersecurity defense, landing a firm lead in SEC-bench Pro (88.2%) for finding vulnerabilities, ExploitGym (54.8%) for exploitation, and CWE-bench (71.0%) for patching.
ai_key_details: On internal benchmarks, Carbon drives a strong uplift in generating secure code, and in live coding environments with our own teams it shows reduced misalignment and fabrication rates.
Building on Gemini 4 Argon, which was launched two weeks ago, Carbon illustrates the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward.
Gemini 4 Carbon will launch at the same introductory price 1 as Argon at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens priced at 95% off input token price.
Carbon achieves a state-of-the-art 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, autonomously uncovering complex flaws buried in real-world software.
ai_why_it_matters: Advances Frontier Models capabilities through verified disclosures from Google DeepMind.
ai_technical_breakdown: Our researchers and models are working hand in hand to advance capabilities faster, while strengthening our safeguards in tandem.

ai_industry_impact.Developers: Enables integration of Google DeepMind updates into engineering workflows.
ai_industry_impact.Enterprises: Informs infrastructure decisions and deployment evaluation for Frontier Models.
ai_industry_impact.Researchers: Provides reproducible reference points and capability disclosures from Google DeepMind.

ai_whats_new: - Validating risk through exploitation: To prioritize which vulnerabilities to remediate first or remediate at all, cyber defenders increasingly rely on models to check which vulnerabilities are exploitable.
ai_key_takeaways: We're taking a deliberate approach to rollout and are actively engaged in the U.S.
government’s voluntary process for pre-release model testing.
Starting this week, we will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders and will gradually phase access to additional trusted partners through our Fairwind Program.
ai_limitations: Findings reflect initial publisher reporting; independent replication and production benchmarks remain ongoing.
reported_facts: Official development released and documented by Google DeepMind.
